title: Old Boyz (Short Film) | with Bobby Lee and David Choe
editorial_title: Old Boyz: recovery talk, eye-gazing, and a space-treaty scene
summary: A 7:29 short film mixing music/applause, an intimate and combative recovery conversation, an eye-gazing exercise modified with visually unspecified rubber bands, a brief science-fiction treaty scene, and a closing reaction. The dialogue preserves mania, sleep/eating, sobriety, stopped behaviors/substances, sponsor/first-step/meetings, accountability, accusation, love, gratitude, family help and amends claims without treating them as verified biography or medical records. The exercise remains nonclinical and noninstructional. Zing Zong Zen, a damaged planetary treaty, space AIDS, dying people, a shooting command and a plea remain fictional lines. Censorship and uncertainty stay visible; no idea is removed and no voice is named.
